name: Yui to Onii-chan no Koko Dake no Hanashi
original_name: 結衣とお兄ちゃんのここだけの話
source:
Younger sister Yui is so innocent and cute. But main character discovers her diary that is full of forbidden erotic stories. He is going to confront his sister about it and suggest his expertise on the matter.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/04/vn-of-month-december-2006-kimi-no-koe.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
妹妹结衣是那么纯真可爱，主人公却偶然发现，她的日记里竟写满了禁忌的色情故事。他准备找妹妹当面对质，并凭自己的经验，在这方面亲自指导她。
